additional_info.subject: ID0387064-DC/Si-D/NL[R7VjM6] - NoConverters_CGp_DC4 CRM:00315001977
additional_info.body:
Dear Thomas, welcome back. I hope all is well.
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S7 170003820
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
R7VjM6
Problem Description
: No converters in group 4
Troubleshooting
:
It seems like the converters are not turned on at all, from my point of view, it seems that the fastshutdown signal is constantly ON in this group.
What we need to do is check if QA40 is indeed closed or opened. My feeling that we have 11-14 closed when it shouldn't. Measure if we have continuity between 11-14 or 12V.
Otherwise we need to check why the converters are not turned ON. We can try 2 things, either swap QA40 with for example QA42 and see the result and afterwards swap converter from DC4 with another group and see.
What are your thoughts?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387064
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0387064-DC/Si-D/NL[R7VjM6] - NoConverters_CGp_DC4 CRM:00315001992
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
The QA40 shouldn’t be the problem right? We swapped it, but without result.
My guess would be to swap the converters instead. Would it also work to only swap the connections of the converters (the two smaller cables), to see if it changes DC groups?
Thomas

additional_info.subject: ID0387064-DC/Si-D/NL[R7VjM6] - NoConverters_CGp_DC4 CRM:00315001992
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas!
I didn't understand correctly that you swapped it.
Yes, then let's please see if there is anything wrong with the converters. We can test changing the fast shutdown cables but we would also need to change the CAN as well otherwise it will do the process for the wrong converters.
I would suggest swapping the whole converter with a working one, this way we know for sure.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: NOTE TO L3
additional_info.body:
1. Problem Description : NoConverters_CGp_DC4 → CAN allocation is done but no grouping  F:0. I couldn't check why this is happening as I didn't have SSH for the first intervention.
2. Action Performed (L2) :
We made 2 interventions so far:
1st intervention: RC was not prepared nor had time, we tried swapping QA42 with QA40, but it didn't work. Also checked for any loose connections in the DC4 converters in the fastshutdown.
2nd intervention: as soon as
customer
(RC was not on site) opened the charger we lost SCB connection, we were supposed to make ELMS work, the configurations are done, there is only one thing to agree which is the IP in the Router 1 config, they need to agree on an IP which is not used in the network where they will ping from their controller.
It seems like the router was connected to the network but we had <2kB data transfer
3. Charger SW Version:4.0.11 → SiD400
4. Reason for Handover (L3) : Post comissioning issue, SSH already available even though charger is offline
5. Fault history : none
6. Log analysis with timestamp : in attach
7. Action Required
Attachement : refer attched logs

additional_info.subject: 0387064 - ID0387064-DC/Si-D/NL[R7VjM6] - NoConverters_CGp_DC4 CRM:00440000280
additional_info.body:
Good Morning Colleagues,
Yesterday we had an intervention on the Charger R7VjM6.
On the Charger we checked the whole cabling together with Peter onside. it seems to be that KF14 has an issue an needs to be replaced.
Order Number (8EM5903-0AA03-2AA6) please order the spare part and plan to install it.
Second Problem with the ELMS Communication has been solved. But still Cars can not be charged as currently the ELMS operator has set the Powerlimit to 0KW.
Please get in contact with them to coordinate if they can set the limit higher. As option B we could deactivate the ELMS and set a static Powerlimit according to the Power that can be delivered from the Grid side until their ELMS Software is ready. then People can at least Charge in this Time Frame.
